scope: Current repaired local runtime with reported Development environment settings, retained timed evidence and a simulated active recognition lifecycle. This does not assert byte-for-byte equivalence to the September 15 deployed build or full acquisition/ASR latency and cost.

runtime_environment.legacy_visual_flag_effect: index.ts constructs withAutomaticDeepRecognition(selectModelProvider(cfg), cfg); it does not invoke withVayrinFallback. Legacy visual/V3 flags therefore do not activate an extra provider in this path.
runtime_environment.decision_context_requirement: autoSaveAuthorized=true and auditRecordPresent=true simulate the enabled audited recognition policy. These are explicit experiment context settings; Edge MEDIA_AUTO_SAVE_ENABLED/canary/audit state must be separately verified or the context declared as a controlled policy assumption.

rate_verification.notes: Standard paid tier. No explicit cache creation, hourly storage API or grounding tools are used. Alias switching is not accepted as a reproducible model choice. The reported deployed model is already explicit.

Promotion documented at least through November 21, 2026; reverify before later runs. Ordinary input = input_tokens - cached_tokens - cache_write_tokens. Output usage already includes reasoning; do not add reasoning_tokens again. Full request receives the long-context tier when input_tokens exceeds 272000. Missing cache_write_tokens is unknown cost, not assumed zero. Request model and provider-reported model/service tier are retained. Non-default service tiers are rejected as unpriced.

Both exact runtime field masks contain displayName/location/types and trigger Pro. Ordinary photos field is metadata; no image-download request is issued. Different field masks require separate exact matching rate cards.
Legacy Text Search does not support a field mask; official SKU documentation says it also triggers data SKUs. No free allowance, subscription or volume discount is assumed.

Official web-search fee also has search-content model token charges. Automatic Deep hardcodes webSearchEnabled=false; transport rejects nonempty request tools and treats unexpected tool-call outputs as unknown charge. A future web-enabled arm requires separate tool-call reservation and accounting; this config does not permit it.

reservation_bounds.explanation: Input reservation uses the smaller of serialized request bytes plus 4096 or verified provider input ceiling; output reserves the provider ceiling. The highest cache-write/input and output rate among possible context tiers is reserved. Provider-bound inconsistencies and missing usage stop the run, keeping reservations outstanding. These are conservative admission bounds, not forecast spend or invoice totals.

remaining_requirements: Finalize seal and approved development pilot selection externally; the runner reads only neutral input.json paths.
Verify or explicitly declare decisionContext true/true as controlled enabled policy.
Create a private immutable copy of the configuration with allowPaidRequests=true only for the already-authorized funded execution.
Use paidBatch.mjs cumulative $50 guard and freeze all runtime outputs before scoring.
Supply provider-only credentials through the local launcher; no DB credentials are needed.
Disclose that retained transcripts exist only when materialized; fresh ASR/acquisition costs and latency are outside this baseline.
